interpretation: Useful primary base and pooled advantage remains unresolved under both interval methods; donor and uniform exclude useful advantage under both. All primary intervals include zero. Residual donor and pooled advantage remains unresolved under both methods; uniform excludes useful advantage under both and resolves worse performance only under writer resampling. Raw sums retain base uncertainty under both methods, exclude pooled advantage under both and retain donor uncertainty only under crossed resampling. All raw model-rival intervals include zero; raw sums are worse than uniform under both methods.
